generalInfo.label: REPORTS.VIEW_REPORT.INSPECTOR_REMARK
generalInfo.value:
1. The factory did not provide any test report during the inspection time.
2. The supplier did not provide PP counter samples from the client, swatch, trim card, or technical file during the inspection time.
3. The metal/needle detection machine was out of service.
4. Measurement checked a total of 32 pcs, and 15 pcs were found out of tolerance; the out-of-tolerance was noticed at +1 3/4 cm to -1 cm as per point. Please refer to the measurement chart for details.
5. Packed 18 pieces with major defects and 7 pieces with minor defects and sealed with QIMA sticker for your reference. Samples were left on-site with the factory representative.
6. No model or doll dummy is available at the factory for this item to check fitting/dummy test.
7. The factory attached only the care label and main label at bulk production (without folding or packing) during the inspection time.
8. As per the booking order quantity of 1,500 pcs, the supplier offered 15 pcs (1.0%) of goods checked completely before poly. A total of 225 pcs were received from washing and are currently in the finishing section, while the balance goods were sent to the wash factory for washing.
9. As per the back-office confirmation, 80 pieces were visually checked, and 32 pieces were measured.
